code:
spend = customers["total_spend"]
mu, sd = spend.mean(), spend.std()
z = (spend - mu) / sd
print((z.abs() > 3).sum())
# 2   (z of about 17.4 and 13.0)
caption: Extremes inflate the std dev and hide the others.
